subject: sakana-meope-symbiosis

metrics.sakana_philosophy: Nature-inspired AI — evolutionary algorithms, swarm intelligence, AI symbiosis vs monolithic models
sakana_technologies: Evolutionary Model Merging — discovers optimal combinations of open-source models via evolution
AI Symbiosis — multiple specialized AI agents working together, each contributing strengths
Swarm Intelligence — decentralized decision-making across model populations
Evolved Optimization — evolutionary discovery of optimization strategies
metrics.meope_ai_positioning: Sakana builds the EVOLUTIONARY ENGINE. meope.ai provides the MEASUREMENT-DRIVEN ROUTING INTELLIGENCE. CSOAI measurement plane tells meope.ai which model is best for which task, at which capability level, under which governance constraints.
metrics.differentiation: Sakana = model-CREATION company. meope.ai = model-SELECTION company. Doesn't build models, MEASURES them and ROUTES intelligently. Defensible layer above model creation.
metrics.combined_stack: Sakana (creation) + meope (selection+routing) + CSOAI (measurement) = symbiotic AI stack

honest_sentence: Sakana.ai (David Ha + Llion Jones, Tokyo 2023) validates symbiosis > monolithic scaling. meope.ai is the measurement-driven routing layer on top — Sakana creates, meope selects, CSOAI measures.
